scenario: Time arithmetic per LTIM.4.1 — `Time - Time` produces `Duration`, `Time + Duration` produces `Time` (preserving the LHS's `tz_offset_s`). Pin: `now() - m.fired_at` (a Time-Time subtraction) compiled as part of a comparison against a literal duration parses cleanly.
rules_ds:
schema Event scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    fired_at: Time mutable

rule old_event:
    Event m where (now() - m.fired_at) > 1_h
->
    log info "old: {m.entity_id}"
